item.description:
0.11.0

Mac habits, put back where they belong.

Changed — one key swapped

Return renames a file. ⌘↓ downloads it. It was the other way round, and that was the Windows Explorer habit rather than the Mac one — Finder, Transmit and ForkLift all put rename on Return.

The two mistakes are not the same size. Press Return expecting a download and you get a name field, which Esc closes. Press it expecting a rename and you started a 400 MB transfer you cannot take back.

  • Settings is rebuilt — related rows grouped into cards, the explanation below the card instead of inside it, labels left and controls right, icons on the tabs, and no heavy bezel on pop-up buttons.
  • The session list handles a long one. The SSH icon is legible (server.rack is a smudge of stripes at 13pt), rows are shorter so fifteen hosts fit where twelve did, and a group shows how many hosts are inside it.
  • The serial transfer pane lines up — its title, buttons and history each landed in a different place.
